reference: PLAN: 1. Find information about who wrote "The Six Arms Saga". 2. Identify the former editor-in-chief of the company that employed the author found in step 1.

corruptions.text: PLAN: First, identify the 2003 action-adventure platforming video game mentioned in the paragraph. Next, check if this game was written by Reid Harrison.

descendants.aggregator: Final answer: The Six Arms Saga was written by the former editor-in-chief of Marvel Comics.
